title: Curvature of a Plane Circle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the curvature kappa of a circle of radius 4 defined by r(t) = <4 cos(t), 4 sin(t)>.

steps.title: Compute Velocity and Speed
steps.explanation: The speed along a circle of radius 4 with standard parametrization is constant at 4.

steps.title: Compute Unit Tangent Vector and Derivative
steps.explanation: Divide v by 4 and differentiate with respect to t.
steps.why: Finding rate of tangent direction turn.

steps.title: Calculate Curvature
steps.explanation: Curvature is the reciprocal of the radius of the circle.
